the_new_problem_this_creates: 五絕 references are now TINY. 唐寅 has 5 scored 五絕 and 文徵明 has 5. A P2/P3 comparison against a bar of five poems is not a comparison. My 10455 recommendation stands and is stronger: score on 七絕 and report 五絕 as observed.
note_on_model_古絕: A generated poem classified 古體 when a 七絕 was ASKED for is a failure to follow the form, not a poem that should leave the pool — so in the model arms it counts as not-passing over all 50 attempts.
